answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the umber graph. Re-attestations are stored in ripple and summit lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1399 impostors cost 224 times the honest price and take 9 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
